doc.description:
Basic light scheduler using WS2812 driver
WS2812 are small RGB leds controlled with a 1-wire protocol. This module is an example of controlling several leds with the color changing continuously. Implementation for ChibiOS using DMA.

configure.name: WS2812_TIM
configure.description: Select the timer used to control the LEDs

define.name: LIGHT_SCHEDULER_MODE
define.description: Startup mode: 0 rainbow, 1 fixed color, 2 off

define.name: LIGHT_SCHEDULER_RED
define.description: Startup red value of the fixed color (0-255)

define.name: LIGHT_SCHEDULER_GREEN
define.description: Startup green value of the fixed color (0-255)

define.name: LIGHT_SCHEDULER_BLUE
define.description: Startup blue value of the fixed color (0-255)

define.name: LIGHT_SCHEDULER_ALERT
define.description: Optional C condition: while true, all LEDs show the alert color in every mode

define.name: LIGHT_SCHEDULER_ALERT_HEADER
define.description: Header to include for the alert condition
